metric_limits: Answer EM and token F1 measure lexical reference overlap, not semantic correctness or faithfulness.
Known supplied source citations are stripped with the existing scorer; no citation-support or semantic-judge metric is implemented.
Canonical retrieval20 and secondary binary graded17 use full candidate rankings; top5 context coverage is separate.
Retrieval metrics include all logical conditions independently of QA validity.
